title: Harness precheck must judge acceptance on origin/main's tree, never on a reused worktree's branch
goal: Observed 2026-10-31 in a live engine mission: 'susi workflow start' reused the worktree an earlier run left behind (susi-worktree.sh: 'already exists - reusing it'), whose branch carried the earlier worker's commit efa6fa3f6 replacing tests/gmcp_requirements.rs (13,869 lines) with 200 lines holding one new test. The adapter's precheck ran the acceptance there, saw that lone test pass, closed T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-83 as 'already passes on the untouched base', published a close receipt and reported 'merged' with zero model calls. The precheck must only close when the worktree's HEAD tree equals origin/main plus at most the task record (git diff origin/main --stat is empty apart from .agents/tasks), and a reused worktree whose branch is ahead with code must be reset to origin/main before any attempt or precheck runs. In the same adapter: before commit_work, close or finish, compare every changed .rs file against the base and reject the attempt when its #[test] count drops (recording the rejection as a failure the ladder reads, never a success), the in-process counterpart of the gate check scripts/parallel-workflow.sh gained under T-AGENT202610310754411067899-2.
